If execution reaches the next statement, launch a new on_error thread on the implicit object context, then return true. Do not assume assertmsg returns: native assertion behavior may prevent the later launch/return. The on_error call can involve class dispatch/overrides; the declaration candidates are recorded separately without claiming the actual dynamic implementation. No error state is assigned by this body itself.
